path.description: Exact virtual path of the document to read. Supports both path shortcuts and content shortcuts — see this tool's description for the full reference.

targetUserId.description: Org owner/admin only: the org member whose documents to operate on instead of your own (e.g. to read or edit their playbook). Omit to operate on your own documents.

ownerUserId.description: Read the copy of this PATH owned by this person (list-documents rows carry ownerUserId). Path reads only, not document ids. Only among documents you can already read.

includeHistory.description: Also return the last few edit sessions (when, who, origin, word change; no content). Use to see whether and by whom a doc such as an agent spec was recently changed.

path.description: Path prefix to list under. Supports path shortcuts — see this tool's description for the full reference.

targetUserId.description: Org owner/admin only: the org member whose documents to operate on instead of your own (e.g. to read or edit their playbook). Omit to operate on your own documents.

query.description: Search query. Supports Postgres case-insensitive regex (~*). Examples: "pricing", "CRO initiative", "kyle.*figma", "objection|blocker".

path.description: Optional path prefix or shortcut to scope the search. Omit to search across all docs.

count_only.description: When true, return only the total count without result excerpts.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching documents to return (max 20). Default: 10.

context_lines.description: Number of surrounding lines to include in each excerpt. Default: 5.

targetUserId.description: Org owner/admin only: the org member whose documents to operate on instead of your own (e.g. to read or edit their playbook). Omit to operate on your own documents.

user_request_summary.description: One sentence, in your own words: what the user actually asked you to do in this turn. Used only for Cedar's observability — it does not change what this tool does.

is_new_request.description: true on the FIRST Cedar tool call of a NEW user request; false when this call continues the same request you are already working on. Groups related calls into one activity thread.
